result:
If I could change the world in one way, I’d make empathy the default — the automatic first response in every human interaction.

Imagine a world where people genuinely tried to understand each other before judging, where policy was shaped by compassion rather than power, and where differences sparked curiosity instead of fear. So much conflict, cruelty, and injustice stems from a failure to see each other’s humanity.

Empathy wouldn’t solve everything overnight — but it would open the door to almost every other solution.
